$comment: Maps old .github/instructions/*.instructions.md files and .github/skills/<name> skills found across the 4D repositories to their new home. status: skill = now a skill in miyako/skills (url = skill folder on main); repo-instruction = stays in the repository as the given instruction path (skill = the skill that now owns the generic part, if any); deleted = removed, nothing replaces it.

variable.declarations.instructions.md.note: C_* to var / #DECLARE conversion: skills/4dmodernise/references/declarations.md. Version detection and token rules are owned by 4dproject.

method.visibility.instructions.md.note: Method attributes (invisible, preemptive, shared, published, executedOnServer) in .4dm headers; what to hide from the Run Method dialog.

listbox.instructions.md.note: List box defaults (truncateMode none, resizingMode legacy): skills/4dform/references/objects/listbox.md.

css.instructions.md.note: Stylesheets and dark mode: skills/4dcss/SKILL.md and references/dark-mode.md.

tahoe.css.instructions.md.note: Liquid Glass / Fluent UI form themes: skills/4dcss/references/form-themes.md.

localisation.instructions.md.note: XLIFF, :xliff: references, Localized string, language-following attributes. The .gitignore and version rules moved to 4dproject.

aikit.async.instructions.md.note: 4D AI Kit async callbacks and streaming; the window pattern is in 4dstartup.

startup.instructions.md.note: Split: the generic non-blocking startup / form-chaining pattern is now the 4dstartup skill (https://github.com/miyako/skills/tree/main/4d-skills/skills/4dstartup); the HDI splash-form specifics stay in HDI repositories as hdi.startup.instructions.md.

readme.structure.instructions.md.note: Repository-specific (HDI README structure); stays in HDI_Template and HDI repositories.

readme.branches.instructions.md.note: Repository-specific (HDI branch/README conventions, HDI_Template variant without the token table); stays in HDI_Template and HDI repositories.

readme.usage.guidance.instructions.md.note: Copilot token/model/session usage guidance was removed everywhere; strip any such README section.

readme.hdi.instructions.md.note: Older version of readme.structure.instructions.md; superseded by it.

technote-translation.instructions.md.note: Technote pipeline reference; stays in the technote-localisation template and its derived repositories.

copilot-instructions.md.note: Repository-wide instructions move into the repository's root AGENTS.md (vendor-neutral); no .github/copilot-instructions.md.

apply-glossary.note: Technote-localisation repositories only (technote.json at the root).

review-figures.note: Technote-localisation repositories only (technote.json at the root).

localise-demo-data.note: Technote-localisation repositories only (technote.json at the root).

release-technote.note: Technote-localisation repositories only (technote.json at the root).

localise-4d-project.note: Technote-specific parts (demo/ scope, tools/tool4d.py, commit split). The generic 4D rules moved to 4dlocalise, 4dstartup, 4dmodernise, 4dmethods, 4dform, 4dcss and 4dproject.

4d-docs.note: Verified developer.4d.com index for form objects: skills/4dform/references/docs-index.md. Doc and forum search fallback: 4dlang ("When the lookup tools have no answer").

form_layout_calc.py.note: Generalised calculator, now with --form to check a .4DForm page: skills/4dform/scripts/form_layout_calc.py.

4d-project-instructions.md.note: 4d-catalog-tutorial only; not migrated yet (left untouched). Its topics are covered by 4dproject (project layout, .gitignore) and 4dcatalog.

tool4d-cli.md.note: 4d-catalog-tutorial only; not migrated yet (left untouched). Its topic is covered by 4dcli.

plugin-dev.instructions.md.note: 4D plugin repositories; out of scope for now (left untouched).
